name: @daily/core
description: TypeScript type bindings for the kernel (@daily/core) Rust data-access layer.

scripts.build: cargo run --quiet --manifest-path migration/Cargo.toml --bin migration-export -- generated/pglite/migrations postgres && cargo run --quiet --manifest-path migration/Cargo.toml --bin migration-export -- generated/sqlite/migrations sqlite && wasm-pack build --target web --dev
